title: Juicy Thai Carrot Stir-fry
description: A herbal and juicy Polish dish featuring coriander to create a cozy and whole30-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat.
Add carrots and cook until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic and continue cooking for another minute.
Mix lime juice and sugar in a small bowl. Pour this mixture over the vegetables and stir well to coat them evenly.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until carrots are tender but still crisp.
Remove from heat, add chopped coriander, and toss gently to combine.
Serve hot as a side dish.
